ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light gray) to 15% low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels form a continuous border along the entire trailing edge and median notch. Distinct dark vertical streaks and focal spots are distributed across both lobes, with a prominent vertical mark centered on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; serration is most pronounced on the inner lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Consistent convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips, with a sharp upward taper at the furthest points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured clusters of white and dark pixels visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating localized surface disruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three distinct, parallel dark diagonal marks (rake marks) are visible on the mid-right lobe; additional unaligned dark linear streaks are present on the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular scalloping of the trailing edge; calcified-appearing white texture at the lobe tips.
